meta.title: Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Switch between the unnamed Growth and Enterprise tenants and sign in as the Compliance Officer on both.
Check that Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks are absent or unavailable on Growth.
Use a vendor email domain or PAN belonging to a group entity and verify onboarding is blocked on Growth.
Repeat the same onboarding checks on Enterprise and verify the capability is available and blocks as expected.
